info.title: VARA API
info.description: Women-only ride-hailing for Windhoek. Amounts are integer cents of NAD.

422.description: Not a valid Namibian mobile number

429.description: Too many codes for this number or IP; see Retry-After

200.description: Signed in
New token pair; the old refresh token is now spent

401.description: Unknown, expired, revoked or reused refresh token

200.description: Submitted for review

201.description: Added; replaces the current document of this kind

200.description: Earnings dashboard (PRD P-6)

204.description: Recorded. The app normally sends this over the WebSocket (`location.update`).

200.description: Offline: no new requests. A trip in progress continues.
Online: requests can arrive
Her weekly statements, newest first (the last 26 weeks)
Online state, pending request and current trip (refetch after reconnecting)

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Trips requested before this time (the last item's `requested_at`); omit for the newest.

200.description: Her trips, newest first, 20 at a time
Fares for every ride type, in integer cents of NAD

422.description: Invalid request (unknown field, outside service area, too short)

get.summary: The process is up. Never touches dependencies, so a database outage doesn't cause restarts.

200.description: The process is up

202.description: Signed out everywhere; personal data is erased after 30 days

409.description: `active_ride`: finish or cancel the current ride first
`identity_locked`: name and date of birth are under review or verified

200.description: Her favourite drivers; matching prefers them

204.description: Removed (also when she wasn't a favourite)

422.description: An upload is missing, not yours, of the wrong kind or was rejected

200.description: The ride is hers: drive to the pickup area

409.description: `offer_gone`: expired, withdrawn, or the rider cancelled

503.description: `busy`: try again. The accept may already have landed, so check `/v1/driver/status`

204.description: Declined; the request goes to the next driver

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: An action (`user.suspend`) or a prefix ending in a dot (`user.`).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Entries older than this id (the last `id` of the previous page).

200.description: Up to 100 entries, newest first; page with `before`

401.description: Email, password or code is wrong (never says which)

429.description: 5 attempts per 15 minutes per account and IP

200.description: Submitted applications, oldest first

409.description: `not_pending`, or `not_ready`: documents, vehicle or tiers not all approved

200.description: Incidents not yet closed: SOS and unanswered RideChecks first, then newest first

204.description: Closed. For a PIN lockout the blocked trip is cancelled and the driver can get requests again

404.description: No such incident, or already closed

200.description: Every message on the incident's ride, oldest first, across all its drivers (empty without a ride). Each view goes in the audit log

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Days to count back from now, 1–90 (default 7).

200.description: Counts for the period and right now
The rates in force for each ride type, and any that start later

201.description: New rates added; quotes use them from `effective_from`

409.description: Rates already start at that moment for this ride type (`duplicate_start`)

200.description: Reported issues, oldest first (open) or newest first
Every editable parameter with its bounds
Saved; matching and RideCheck use it from their next run
Weekly statements: pending (oldest first) or the last 200 settled
Recorded as settled; her balance is reduced by the amount
Surge zones by name
Saved; new quotes in the zone use it at once

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A phone number (`+264…` or `081…`), or part of a name (at least 2 characters).

200.description: Up to 50 matches: the exact phone number, or names containing the text
The person, her last trips and her reports (the view is audited)

204.description: Rides she accepts until then pay the flat 15 % Map Expert fee; granting again moves the date

422.description: The date is not in the future, or more than a year ahead

204.description: Ended now: rides she accepts from now on pay the tier's fee

409.description: She is not a Map Expert (`not_map_expert`)

200.description: Adjusted (clamped to 0–150) and recorded in the priority ledger

204.description: Reinstated: active again if verified, else back to pending
Suspended: signed out of every request from now on; a driver is taken offline

200.description: Pending verifications whose photos passed the upload checks, oldest first

409.description: `not_pending`: already decided, or photos still being checked

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Up to 80 characters. Empty returns the landmarks (quick-place chips).

200.description: Up to 20 places, best first
A name for a point on the map (the pickup pin)

get.summary: The process can serve traffic: Postgres and Redis answer.

200.description: Postgres and Redis answer

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Trips requested before this time (the last item's `requested_at`); omit for the newest.

200.description: Her trips, newest first, 20 at a time

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Random per booking attempt; a retry with the same key returns the same ride

200.description: Same Idempotency-Key as an earlier request: that ride

403.description: `not_verified`: identity verification must be approved first

422.description: Invalid or expired quote, bad schedule time, unsupported payment

200.description: The rider's active or scheduled ride
Locked prices for every ride type, valid for 5 minutes

422.description: Outside the service area, too short, or no road route

404.description: Not found, or not her ride

200.description: Arrived: the exact pickup is unlocked; ask for the PIN

409.description: `not_at_pickup` (more than 50 m away, or no recent position) or `invalid_state`

200.description: Cancelled. Free, but every cancellation costs priority (PRD D-5)
Cash recorded (tapping again changes nothing)
Completed. Cash: collect the locked fare

204.description: Released: the request goes back to the pool without her. Free, but it costs priority (PRD T-7)

200.description: This conversation; empty until the first message, and for a rider between drivers

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Random per message; a resend with the same key returns the same message and tells nobody twice

200.description: Saved and on its way to the other person

409.description: `chat_closed`: the trip is over, blocked or has no driver

422.description: Not exactly one of `text` and `quick_reply`, empty, over 500 characters, or an unknown quick reply

200.description: Cancelled as a rider no-show: free, and it counts against the rider
Correct: the destination is unlocked

409.description: `pin_locked`: that was the 5th wrong PIN; the trip is blocked and the safety desk alerted. Or `invalid_state`

422.description: `wrong_pin` (the message says how many attempts are left) or not 4 digits

200.description: Rated

422.description: No reason below 3 stars, a reason for the other side, or `favourite` from the driver app

200.description: Skipped (the driver's "Back to requests")

201.description: Recorded; safety categories also reach the safety desk

404.description: Not her ride, or more than 30 days ago

200.description: Searching again; drivers who passed before may be asked again
A new live link to her trip; each call makes another

409.description: The ride has no driver yet or has ended (`not_shareable`)

200.description: In trip: drive to the destination

409.description: `invalid_state`: the PIN must be verified first

200.description: The 5-minute free wait is running (starting it again changes nothing)

409.description: `invalid_state`: only at the pickup, before the PIN

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The `ride_check.id` from her view of the ride

200.description: Recorded; *help* also raised an SOS

404.description: No such check on her rides

200.description: The safety desk has the incident and her contacts are being texted (a repeat within 2 minutes returns the same incident). A `ride_id` that isn't hers is ignored
The shared trip, live. Poll every 10 s

404.description: No such link, or it was stopped

410.description: The link expired 30 minutes after the trip ended (`link_expired`)

429.description: Too many lookups from this address

403.description: Driver documents can only be uploaded from the driver app

expires_on.description: Required for licence, insurance, police clearance and transport permit; must be in the future.

upload_id.description: A completed upload with the same purpose as `kind`.

App.description: Which app a session belongs to. One person can hold both (PRD A-9), with separate sessions.

can_go_online.description: All checks passed: the driver may go online (Phase 2).

missing_documents.description: Required document kinds with no current upload, or whose current one was rejected or expired.

ready_to_submit.description: Everything needed to submit is present.

lat.description: Centre of the circle: the pickup moved 100–200 m in a random direction.

eta_s.description: Estimated seconds until she reaches the pickup.

balance.description: Her balance after this trip: negative means she owes VARA.

service_fee.description: VARA's service fee on this trip, added to what she owes.

Cents.description: An amount of Namibian dollars in cents. Money is never a float.

quick_reply.description: The quick reply's ID, when it was one.

text.description: Plain text: render it as text, never as HTML.

can_send.description: False once the trip is over or blocked: the conversation stays readable.

messages.description: Oldest first: the newest 200 of this conversation.

quick_replies.description: The buttons to offer this person.

CloseIncident.description: What the safety desk found, kept on the incident and in the audit log.

outcome.example: Rider's phone was off; spoke to both, no safety concern.

document_ids.description: IDs from `pending_consents` on `GET /me`; each must be the latest version of its kind.

size_bytes.description: Exact size of the file in bytes, at most 10 MB.

Decision.description: A review decision. A rejection needs a reason, which the applicant sees.

reason.example: The ID photo is blurred. Please retake it in good light.

upload_reject_reason.description: Set when the file itself was refused by the upload checks.

earning.description: What she earns for this trip, in cents.

no_show_from.description: From then she may cancel as a rider no-show (`POST /rides/{id}/no-show`).

payment_status.description: Once the trip is complete: `pending` until she confirms the cash, then `cash_confirmed`.

pin_attempts_left.description: Wrong PINs she may still enter before the trip is blocked.

rated.description: She has rated the passenger or skipped rating (PRD R-1).

wait_started_at.description: When she started the free wait at the pickup.

oneOf.description: Set while she gets no requests after a PIN lockout; she may stay online meanwhile.
The request on her screen, if any (15 s to answer).
The trip she is on, if any.

tiers.description: Ride types she receives requests for.

dropoff_address.description: Only if the PIN was verified.

pickup_address.description: Only if she reached the pickup.

balance.description: All-time balance: positive means VARA pays her at settlement, negative means she owes VARA.

earnings.description: What she earned: fares minus VARA's service fee.

recent.description: Completed trips in the period, newest first.

service_fees.description: VARA's service fee on these trips.

contacts.description: Up to 3, in order of who to alert first.

ErrorBody.description: Documentation shape of every error response.

message.description: Safe to show to the user.

currency.description: Amounts are integer cents of NAD.

driver_earning.description: What the driver earns: total − service fee.

minimum_adjustment.description: Top-up to reach the tier minimum (zero when the trip is long enough).

total.description: What the rider pays: base + distance + time + minimum_adjustment + surge.

phone.description: Receives the driver, plate and PIN by SMS once a driver accepts (PRD B-5).

oneOf.description: The ride's driver: for a PIN lockout, who is held until this incident is closed.
Who pressed SOS or reported; absent for incidents the system raised (RideCheck).

ridecheck_answer.description: RideCheck: `fine` or `help` when she answered after the desk was alerted.

oneOf.description: The ride's rider, to call (RideCheck, or an SOS from the driver).

driver_id.description: The driver on the ride at the time. It changes if one cancelled and another took over.

text.description: Plain text: render it as text, never as HTML.
Plain text: render it as text, never as HTML.

safety.description: The safety desk has it as an incident.

text.description: What happened, in her words (1–2000 characters, plain text).

LatLng.description:
A point inside the service area. v1 serves Windhoek plus about 20 km; the bounding box is
replaced by the `service_areas` polygon once the database is wired in.

reason.description: Why (the zones she maps, who asked), for the audit log.

until.description: The status lapses at this time; at most a year ahead.

display_name.description: First name, shown to the other party on a ride.

driver_application.description: Driver application status, or null if this person has never applied to drive.

identity_locked.description: Name and date of birth can no longer be changed in the app (identity under review or verified).

pending_consents.description: Documents to accept before continuing (PRD A-7).

profile_complete.description: Name and date of birth are filled in.

median_match_min.description: Median minutes from request to a driver accepting.

median_verification_h.description: Median hours from a rider submitting her ID to the decision.

no_drivers.description: Requests that found no driver at least once.

requested.description: Rides requested in the period (scheduled ones by their request time).

effective_from.description: When the rates start; now when absent. Never in the past.

OfferCard.description: The request card (PRD D-4). No destination, no exact pickup.

distance_m.description: Road distance and time from her position to the pickup.

seconds_left.description: Seconds left to answer, as of sending.

dev_code.description:
Local development only: the code itself, so sign-in works without a real SMS gateway.
Never present in any other environment.

resend_after_s.description: Seconds before another code can be requested for this number.

phone.description: Namibian mobile number; `081 123 4567` and `+264811234567` are both accepted.

device_name.description: Shown in the user's list of signed-in devices, e.g. "Samsung Galaxy A15".

phone.description: The same number the code was sent to.

Passenger.description: Who the driver is picking up (PRD D-4, B-5).

booked_by.description:
For a guest: "booked by Ndeshi (verified)". The demo showed a guest as "Verified" with
the booker's rating, which was wrong.

name.description: First name of the rider, or the guest's name.

rating.description: The booking rider's rating; absent for a guest.

PayoutAccount.description: Bank account for weekly payouts. Stored encrypted; never returned by the API.

pin.description: The 4 digits the passenger shows or says.

address.description: What to show for the pin, e.g. "Sam Nujoma Drive" or "Near Maerua Mall".

delta.description: Points to add (negative to remove), −50 to 50. The balance stays within 0–150.

previous_attempts.description: Earlier verifications by this person (all rejected).

duration_s.description: Trip time at the current demand level.

fare.description: The exact price for this ride type, in cents (PRD B-3).

pickup_eta_s.description:
Seconds for the nearest available driver to reach the pickup; null when no driver of
this type is online within the dispatch radius ("No driver online within 3 km").

state.description: `COMPLETED`, or `RATED` once both sides are done.

RatingReason.description:
Why a trip got fewer than 3 stars. The rider rates the driver, the driver rates the rider;
some reasons apply to one side only.

favourite.description: Rider only: add this driver to her favourites.

reason.description: Why, for the audit log and (for a suspension) the user's record.

note.description: What was done, for the audit log.

url.description: Short-lived link to the sanitised file, once it has passed the upload checks.

oneOf.description: Where the phone is, for the SOS when she asks for help.

answer.description: The answer on record (the first one, if she answered before).

oneOf.description: The SOS raised by *Call for help*.

answer_by.description: After this the safety desk is alerted; she can still answer.

escalated.description: The safety desk has been alerted (no answer in time).

kind.description: `deviation` (off the planned route) or `stop` (stopped, or no position from the car).

scheduled_for.description: Book ahead: 30 minutes to 7 days from now (PRD B-6).

RideVehicle.description: The assigned car as the rider sees it.

fare.description: The locked price (PRD P-1), in cents.

guest_name.description: Set when booked for someone else.

payment_status.description: Once the trip is complete: `pending`, then `cash_confirmed` (or a card status).

pin.description: Say it to the driver at pickup. Never sent to the driver.

rated.description: She has rated this trip (PRD R-1).

oneOf.description: RideCheck's *Are you okay?*, while she hasn't answered (PRD S-3). Never in the driver's view.

search_started_at.description: When the current search started (searching rides).

trip_duration_s.description: Trip time once she is in the car ("trip takes Y min", PRD T-1).

wait_started_at.description: The driver's 5-minute free wait started (after it she may cancel as a no-show).

my_rating.description: The stars she gave, if she rated.

oneOf.description: Omit to keep the account already saved.

requested_tiers.description: Ride types the driver wants to offer; ops decide which are approved.

tiers.description: The full set of approved tiers; an empty list removes them all.

updated_at.description: When staff last changed it; absent for a value never changed since it was installed.

value.description: The stored value; absent when the default is used.

reference.description: The bank transfer or deposit slip reference.

amount.description: Positive: VARA pays her. Negative: she pays VARA (service fees on cash trips).

send_to_contacts.description: Also text the link to her emergency contacts (*Send to my emergency contacts*).

ShareStatus.description: Where the shared trip is, in words a contact understands.

SharedTrip.description: The public trip page's data. Nothing here identifies the rider beyond her first name.

destination_area.description: "Near Maerua Mall" or "Klein Windhoek area", never the address.

eta.description: Expected arrival at the pickup (before it) or at the destination (in the trip).

expires_at.description: When the link stops working, once the ride has ended.

oneOf.description: The car's last reported position; absent once the trip has ended.

shared_by.description: First name of whoever shared the link.

new_user.description: True when this sign-in created the account: the app continues to "Your details".

contacts_alerted.description: Emergency contacts being texted (0 if she has none).

police_phone.description: Offered as a one-tap call: Namibian Police.

SosRequest.description:
Deliberately lenient: an SOS is never refused over its details, so unknown fields are
ignored and the location may be anywhere (she may have been driven out of Windhoek).

oneOf.description: Where the phone is. When unknown or invalid, a driver's last reported position is used.

ride_id.description: Her ride; when absent or not hers, her current one (if any).

amount.description: Positive: VARA pays her. Negative: she pays VARA (service fees on cash trips).

status.description: `pending`, `sent` (VARA paid her) or `received` (VARA received her payment).

incident_id.description: The safety desk has it too.

demand_level.description: `normal`, `high` or `peak` (sets the traffic factor on trip times).

Tier.description: Ride types, cheapest first. The order is significant: a higher tier charges more.

current.description: In force now (the latest started row of its tier).

access_token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Valid for `expires_in` seconds.

refresh_token.description:
Single use: exchange at `POST /v1/auth/refresh` for a new pair. Store it only in the
device keychain/keystore.

contacts_texted.description: Emergency contacts being texted the link (0 unless asked for).

text.description: The text for the share sheet.

reject_reason.description: Why the file was refused, written for the user.

method.description: Send the file with this method to `url`, with exactly these headers.

map_expert_until.description: A driver's Map Expert status (flat 15 % fee) ends then; in the past means it lapsed.

trips.description: The last 20 trips on either side.

as_party.description: `rider` or `driver`: her side of this trip.

id_document_url.description: Short-lived links to the sanitised images.

id_document_upload_id.description: Upload with purpose `identity`: national ID card or passport photo page.

national_id.description: 11-digit Namibian ID or passport number. Encrypted; used to stop duplicate accounts.
